items.a: We build custom software and websites, set up and manage online stores and marketplace accounts, design brands, and run digital marketing and SEO — all from one team.

items.q: Where are you based, and do you work with clients abroad?
items.a: Our office is in Rawalpindi, Pakistan. We work with clients across Pakistan, the UK and the US, remotely.
Book a free consultation through our contact page or call us. We will learn about your goals and come back with a plan and a quote.

items.q: Is the first consultation really free?
items.a: Yes. The first consultation is free and there is no obligation to go ahead.

items.q: Can you build software around our existing processes?
items.a: Yes. We map how your team works today and build the system to fit — ERP, LMS, POS, accounts and more.

items.q: Do you build desktop software as well as web apps?
items.a: Yes. We build browser-based systems, desktop applications and websites.

items.q: Will my website be fast and work on mobile?
items.a: Yes. We build on Next.js with responsive layouts, so your site loads quickly and looks right on every screen.

items.q: Do you offer support after launch?
items.a: Yes. Every project includes 30 days of free support after launch. After that, we offer monthly maintenance plans that cover updates, backups, security checks and small changes.

items.q: Which e-commerce platforms do you work with?
items.a: Shopify, WordPress WooCommerce, Amazon, eBay and Walmart.

items.q: Can you manage our marketplace accounts day to day?
items.a: Yes — listings, pricing, orders and performance, for new or existing accounts.

items.q: Can you set up online payments?
items.a: Yes. We set up secure checkout and payment gateways for your store.

items.q: What is included in a branding project?
items.a: Logo design, colour palette, typography, brand guidelines and a stationery set (business cards, letterhead and envelope). Social media templates and packaging can be added.

items.q: Which marketing channels do you manage?
items.a: Social media, Google Ads, SMS and email marketing.

items.q: How do you report on results?
items.a: You get a clear monthly report covering reach, clicks, leads, sales and spend, plus a short call to agree next month’s plan. You also have access to your ad dashboards at any time.

items.q: How much does a project cost?
items.a: It depends on scope. After the free consultation we send a clear, fixed quote. Larger projects are split into milestones, and ongoing services are billed monthly.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: A business website typically takes 2–4 weeks, an online store 3–6 weeks, and custom software 6–16 weeks depending on the modules. You get a timeline with your quote.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Bank transfer (Pakistan and international), Payoneer, Wise and PayPal. Local clients can also pay by cheque or cash at our Rawalpindi office.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: How we collect, use and protect your information when you visit our website or work with us.

sections.heading: Information we collect
paragraphs: When you contact us or request a consultation, we collect the details you give us — such as your name, email address, phone number, company and project details.
When you visit our website, we may automatically collect technical information such as your IP address, browser type, pages visited and time spent on the site.

sections.heading: How we use your information
paragraphs: We use your information to respond to enquiries, provide quotes, deliver our services, send invoices, and improve our website.
We will only send you marketing messages if you have agreed to receive them, and you can opt out at any time.

sections.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: Our website uses cookies to keep it working properly and to understand how visitors use it. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings; some parts of the site may not work as intended without them.

We use Google Analytics to understand how visitors use our website, and may use the Meta Pixel to measure the results of our own advertising. You can block these cookies in your browser settings at any time.

sections.heading: Sharing your information
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information. We share it only with service providers who help us run our business — such as hosting, email and payment providers — and only as needed to provide our services, or where the law requires it.

sections.heading: Data security
paragraphs: We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your information. No method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, but we work to protect your data and limit access to those who need it.

sections.heading: How long we keep data
paragraphs: We keep personal information only for as long as needed for the purposes above, or as required for legal, tax and accounting reasons. Enquiries that do not become projects are deleted after 24 months; project and billing records are kept for six years.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask us to access, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you, or to stop using it for marketing. To make a request, email info@technomiles.com.

sections.heading: Contact us
paragraphs: Questions about this policy? Email info@technomiles.com or write to us at Office No 3, Third Floor, 61-E, Usman Plaza, Commercial Area, Chaklala Scheme III, Rawalpindi, Pakistan.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.lead: The terms that apply when you use our website or engage Technomiles for a project.

sections.heading: Our services
paragraphs: Technomiles provides software development, website development, e-commerce setup and management, design, digital marketing and SEO services. The exact scope of each project is set out in the proposal or quote we agree with you.

sections.heading: Quotes & payment
paragraphs: Quotes are valid for 30 days from the date issued. Projects start after a 50% deposit; the balance is due on delivery, or in agreed milestones for larger projects. Invoices are payable within 7 days of issue.
Late payments may pause work until the account is brought up to date.

sections.heading: Your responsibilities
paragraphs: You agree to provide the content, access, approvals and feedback we need on time. Delays on your side may affect the timeline and cost.
You confirm that any content you give us (text, images, logos) is yours to use, or that you have permission to use it.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
paragraphs: Ownership of the final deliverables — designs, content and source code created for you — passes to you once all invoices are paid in full. We keep ownership of our pre-existing tools, templates and code libraries, which we license to you for use in your project.
Unless you ask us not to, we may show completed work in our portfolio.

sections.heading: Confidentiality
paragraphs: We keep your business information confidential and use it only to deliver our services to you.

sections.heading: Third-party platforms
paragraphs: Many projects rely on third-party platforms such as Shopify, Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Google and social networks. We are not responsible for their policies, fees, outages or account decisions.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: We deliver our services with reasonable skill and care. Our total liability for any claim is limited to the fees you paid for the project or service concerned, and we are not liable for indirect losses such as lost profits or data.

sections.heading: Ending a project
paragraphs: Either party may end a project with written notice. You pay for work completed up to that point. See our Refund Policy for details.

sections.heading: Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, and any disputes will be handled by the courts of Rawalpindi.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.lead: How cancellations and refunds work for our projects and ongoing services.

sections.heading: Free consultations
paragraphs: Initial consultations are free, so no refund applies.

sections.heading: Deposits
paragraphs: Project deposits cover planning, scheduling and the first stage of work. They are refundable in full if you cancel before work begins, and non-refundable once work has started.

sections.heading: Development & design projects
paragraphs: If you cancel a project, you pay for the work completed up to the date of cancellation. Any amount paid beyond that will be refunded within 14 days.
Completed and approved milestones are not refundable.

sections.heading: Monthly services
paragraphs: Monthly services such as store management, social media and SEO can be cancelled with 30 days’ written notice. Fees for the current month are not refundable.

sections.heading: Advertising spend
paragraphs: Money paid directly to advertising platforms (such as Google or Meta) is controlled by those platforms and cannot be refunded by us.

sections.heading: How to request a refund
paragraphs: Email info@technomiles.com with your name, project and the reason for your request. We aim to reply within 3 working days.

caseStudies.title: One brand, three storefronts: a luxury Shopify store with Amazon and eBay run alongside it.
caseStudies.summary: We designed and built Jawa Jewelers’ Shopify store and manage their Amazon and eBay accounts, so a US fine-jewellery retailer sells everywhere from one catalogue.
overview: Jawa Jewelers is a fine-jewellery retailer with more than 20 years in the trade, selling gold chains, diamond jewellery, custom pieces and pre-owned luxury watches from their store in Missouri and online.
They wanted an online store that felt as premium as their showroom, and one team to look after their marketplace accounts as the catalogue grew.
challenge: Products were listed differently on every channel, photos were inconsistent, and keeping stock and prices in sync between the website, Amazon and eBay took hours of manual work each week.
The old store also made it hard for shoppers to browse by type, metal and budget — the way people actually shop for jewellery.
solution: We designed a dark, gold-accented Shopify theme built around large imagery, clear categories (necklaces, bracelets, pendants, earrings, watches) and a simple path from collection to checkout.

We restructured the catalogue with consistent titles, specs and photography, connected inventory across Shopify, Amazon and eBay, and now manage listings, pricing and orders on all three channels day to day.
deliverables: Custom Shopify theme and store build
Catalogue structure, product copy and SEO
Amazon and eBay store setup and management
Stock and price sync across all channels

results.label: Sales channels run from one catalogue — Shopify, Amazon and eBay
Online sales with free worldwide shipping

caseStudies.title: A clear, welcoming website for a leading Islamabad school with three campuses.
caseStudies.summary: We designed and built a new website for ASAS International School that presents its school, inclusive-education and academy programmes, and makes admissions and contact simple for parents.
overview: Since 2001, ASAS International School has offered a British curriculum from Playgroup to O and A Levels across three campuses in Islamabad — and it is a pioneer of inclusive education in Pakistan.
The school needed a website that reflected its reputation and gave parents quick answers about programmes, campuses and admissions.
challenge: Information was spread across social media and printed brochures, and parents often called the office for basics like timings, locations and how to apply.
The school also wanted to show its three distinct offerings — School, Inclusive Education and Academy — without overwhelming visitors.
solution: We designed a bright, trustworthy site in the school’s navy and gold, with a clear top bar for phone, address and timings and a prominent “Apply Now” button on every page.
Three programme tiles lead parents straight to the right section, and the site is easy for school staff to update with events, news and e-learning links.
deliverables: Website design in the school’s brand colours

results.label: Campuses presented clearly in one place
Programmes — School, Inclusive Education and Academy
Apply Now on every page for parents

caseStudies.title: A business-centre website that fills private offices and e-commerce suites in Burnley.
caseStudies.summary: We built KACEGB Properties’ website to showcase its private offices, office suites and e-commerce suites, and to turn visitors into viewings and enquiries.
overview: KACEGB Properties runs a business centre in the heart of Burnley town centre, offering private offices, office suites and e-commerce suites with storage for online sellers.
They wanted a website that showed off the spaces and spoke directly to entrepreneurs and small e-commerce businesses.
challenge: Potential tenants couldn’t easily compare workspace types or see what was included, so the team spent a lot of time answering the same questions by phone.
As a UK business working with a team in Pakistan, they also needed a partner who was easy to work with across time zones.
solution: We designed a photo-led website with a full-width slider of the spaces, clear workspace categories and simple enquiry paths on every page.
Each workspace type has its own page with features and amenities, and we look after hosting, updates and local SEO so the centre shows up for office searches in Burnley.
deliverables: Local SEO for Burnley office searches

results.label: Workspace types showcased, from start-up desks to e-commerce suites
